en.headline: Sam Tung Uk Museum hosts free ICH Wonder Play Fun Day on Sunday
en.dek: The Hong Kong Intangible Cultural Heritage Centre at Sam Tung Uk Museum offers free performances, workshops and activities from 11am to 6pm on 15 November.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department will hold the “ICH Wonder Play” Fun Day at the Hong Kong Intangible Cultural Heritage Centre, located at Sam Tung Uk Museum in Tsuen Wan, on Sunday.

The free event runs from 11am to 6pm and includes Cantonese music performances at 2pm and 4pm, as well as puppet shows at 2:45pm and 4:45pm, each lasting about 30 minutes. Additional interactive activities and workshops will be available throughout the day.
No advance booking is required for general entry. The museum is near MTR Tsuen Wan Station exits B3 and E. The programme forms part of Muse Fest HK 2026.
Visitors are advised to check the latest details with the venue, as the weather may affect outdoor elements if any.

zh.headline: 三棟屋博物館周日舉行非遺童遊同樂日 免費入場
zh.dek: 香港非物質文化遺產中心（三棟屋博物館）周日上午11時至下午6時提供免費表演、工作坊及活動。
body: 康樂及文化事務署將於周日在荃灣三棟屋博物館的香港非物質文化遺產中心舉行「非遺童遊」同樂日。
活動免費入場，時間由上午11時至下午6時，包括下午2時及4時的廣東音樂表演，以及下午2時45分及4時45分的木偶戲，每場約30分鐘。全日亦有其他互動活動及工作坊。
一般入場毋須預先報名。博物館鄰近港鐵荃灣站B3及E出口。是次節目屬香港博物館節2026的一部分。
市民可向場地查詢最新詳情，因天氣情況或影響部分戶外安排。
